_note: The ONLY source of the Cloudflare spend guard's thresholds and targets (tools/cloudflare_spend_guard.py). There are no environment or command-line overrides by design. Cloudflare has no native hard spending cap: budget alerts 'are informational only. They do not pause or cap usage' (https://developers.cloudflare.com/billing/manage/budget-alerts/), so this guard is the kill switch.
_production_note: Report-only by default; Joe decides whether to turn this on. Even when on, disabling workers.dev does not stop production traffic: carr-mcp serves api.doctorcre.com and other custom domains, and doctorcre-app has workers_dev=false. A real production stop would need a different control.
_allowances_note: Included per billing period, from the cited pricing pages. service_names must match the Billable Usage API's ServiceName exactly. Only 'Workers Standard' is taken from Cloudflare's published schema example; the other names are unverified until the first live read. A service with usage that no allowance maps is a STOP (fail closed), so run `./run.sh cloudflare-spend-guard map-services` once the token exists and copy the exact names here before activating. A service with no allowance (Stream minutes delivered, Images delivered/stored) is covered by the metered-dollar rule.

fast_path._note: The 15-minute fast path (`fast`): ONE POST to the GraphQL endpoint per run, one account scope, every node capped at query_limit rows and at most max_query_span_days per node. Docs: https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/limits/ (1 account per account-scoped query; 300 GraphQL queries per 5-minute window per user), https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/tutorials/querying-workers-metrics/ (workersInvocationsAdaptive; 'up to one month of data'), https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/metrics-and-analytics/ ('maximum increments of one week'; 'a slight delay in aggregation and metrics delivery' in the last few minutes). cpu_time_unit 'microseconds' is the schema's description of cpuTimeP99 as reported secondhand; the docs read here state no unit, so confirm it by schema introspection before activation. The CPU figure is requests x cpuTimeP99 per hour bucket: conservative, but NOT a strict upper bound, because the slowest 1% of requests run above P99 by definition.
fast_path._r2_note: From https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/ (Class A/B/free operation lists). An R2 actionType in neither list counts as Class A, the smaller allowance. A KV actionType other than read/write/delete/list counts as a write.

runaway._note: Item 12, read from the same GraphQL request as the fast path (no extra call). Per Worker, the last burst_window_minutes against the same window on each of the previous history_days days. RUNAWAY when requests >= spike_multiple x that median AND >= floor_requests, or when more than error_ratio_above of more than error_min_requests requests error. Fewer than min_history_days days with traffic: the floor alone decides, and the output line says so. A staging Worker's workers.dev is disabled; any other Worker is alert-only.

loop_watch._note: Items 13-15: tools/cloudflare_loop_watch.py, run by launchd once a minute (template tools/cloudflare-spend-guard/launchd/, NOT installed). Local only: ps, the E2E RunBudget ledgers, its own state. Ledger format from doctorcre-app PR 197 scripts/e2e-staging/run-budget.mjs (schema e2e-run-budget.v1); that file fixes the ledger at <checkout>/.e2e/run-budget/, so the globs cover every doctorcre-app checkout and worktree plus the ~/.local/state/doctorcre-e2e path the brief named. Watched patterns may never match an agent session; the code refuses claude, codex, launchd, the guard and itself regardless.

sources.workers_subdomain: GET/POST /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/{script_name}/subdomain, same schema; token group Workers Scripts Write. The schema marks it x-fern-availability: deprecated (sdk group workers.legacy.scripts.subdomain) and names no successor; the GA PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/workers/workers/{worker_id} carries a subdomain {enabled, previews_enabled} field and is a candidate only.
sources.billing_cycle: Monthly included limits reset on the subscription renewal date, https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/
sources.fast_path: POST /client/v4/graphql; token permission Account > Account Analytics > Read (https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/getting-started/authentication/api-token-auth/)
